STEP 2. Check the turn-signal light and lighting switch.
Q: Is the turn-signal light and lighting switch in good 
condition?
YES : Go to Step 3.
NO : Replace it. The input signal from the column switch 
(turn-signal light and lighting switch) should be able to 
be checked and the functions, which are described in 
the "Technical Description (comment)," should work 
normally.
STEP 3. Replacement of ECU
(1) Replace the column switch.
(2) The input signal from the column switch (turn-signal light 
and lighting switch) should be able to be checked and the 
functions, which are described in the "Technical Description 
(comment)," should work normally.
Q: Is the input signal from the column switch (turn-signal 
light and lighting switch) input normally?
YES : There is no action to be taken.
NO : Replace the ETACS-ECU. The input signal from the 
column switch (turn-signal light and lighting switch) 
should be able to be checked and the functions, 
which are described in the "Technical Description 
(comment)," should work normally.
